findings.issue: Glossary explicitly names 'Ovate's Chamber' as one of the two locations where 'Ovate' (named NPC) must be transliterated أوفيت, not translated as a generic title. This row translates it as العَرّاف ('the diviner').
Glossary freezes 'Hexapod' as السداسيّ الأرجل; this row drops الأرجل, leaving just 'the six-part one'.
Glossary reserves المُريد strictly for Tiel's Acolyte title and says generic 'disciples/followers' must use أتباع, never مريدون/مُريد. This is a generic disciple, not Tiel.
